heading: Tell us who you are musically
intro: Four short steps to get started. None is required, and you can skip any of them.

door1.heading: Albums that define you
door1.intro: Pick 3 to 5 albums that represent you. They're saved to your favorites.
door1.selected: You picked {count, plural, one {# album} other {# albums}}

door2.heading: What are you listening to right now?
door2.intro: Pick an album or a song and it's logged in your diary. You can add your impression later.

error: We couldn't complete the step. Try again.

artists.heading: Artists you want to follow
artists.intro: Following them builds your radar: their releases will show up on Home.
artists.count: {count, plural, =0 {You are not following anyone yet} one {You follow # artist} other {You follow # artists}}
artists.note: Following an artist can appear in your activity, depending on your profile privacy.

summary.heading: You're all set
summary.favorites: {count, plural, one {# favorite album} other {# favorite albums}}
summary.following: {count, plural, one {You follow # artist} other {You follow # artists}}
summary.listens: {count, plural, one {# listen in your diary} other {# listens in your diary}}
summary.empty: You didn't save anything for now. You can start whenever you like from Home.
summary.wanted: {count, plural, one {# item in your Pending list} other {# items in your Pending list}}

wanted.heading: To listen to later
wanted.intro: Save albums and artists you want to listen to. They go to your Pending list.
wanted.count: {count, plural, =0 {You have not saved anything yet} one {You saved # item} other {You saved # items}}
wanted.note: Pending is a list only you can see.
